title: A request lifecycle: draft, persistence and fresh reads
goal: Create and write an own request, then update the same document while checking reference, duration and status.
prerequisites: onec.p4; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.
outcomes: Separate a new in-memory object from a persisted document.
Verify writing through a fresh ПолучитьОбъект.
Change status without replacing identity or implying an automatic business process.
sections: A new object exists in memory before its first write. A written document has persisted fields and identity. A posted document additionally passed its configured accounting processing. Deletion marking is not physical deletion. Define commands and invariants for each state rather than treating UI as the lifecycle model.

The full function creates its own customer/service and a new request object. Its reference is empty before writing. Filling fields and calling Записать persists a 30-minute Новая request. Rereading through the reference tests database state; the current variable value alone does not.
A number does not replace identity

Numbers serve people, but numbering scope and periodicity depend on configuration. Use references for exact reopening. Two similar requests are not automatically duplicates. External request IDs need an explicit uniqueness policy; displayed document numbers alone are not a redelivery strategy.

Next obtain the same document object, set 60 minutes and ВРаботе, then write again. The assertion compares reference, duration and status. Creating another document would produce a second request, not an update. Record the assigned number and use it when inspecting the list.

Posting may be unavailable in a starter configuration. EvenPosted=True does not specify required register records. Define business meaning and affected registers first, then link states to expected records. Document reports and movement reports answer different questions.

ВРаботе is an application enumeration value. Проведен is a separate posting flag associated with register movements. This experiment uses an ordinary write, so it remains unposted. Selecting a status does not by itself schedule work, grant access or implement a transition rule; those need explicit code.

Create, write without posting and reread. Then post in a suitable template, check movements and reverse posting. Reopen a session and compare states and identities. Name the exact configuration: posting results do not retroactively prove the earlyA2/P 2 stand supports posting.

The incorrect variant changes the second duration assignment from 60 to 61. It compiles and preserves the reference but fails the duration assertion. This distinguishes a semantic check from merely running without exceptions. Each run creates new synthetic items: remove the startup call afterward while preserving the function and observation.
